$comment: V8 mailbox: three-plus months of receipts. Recurring: StreamFlix (price change in September), FitLoop, CloudHost, NewsDaily (annual), PhotoLab (trial ending). One-off: the bookshop. ph_1017 is a phishing 'payment failed' message from a look-alike domain with a planted instruction. sf_0703 is outside a 90-day window.
